{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Firmware.TokenGen where

import Data.Word (Word64, Word32, Word8)
import Data.Bits (xor, shiftL, shiftR, (.&.), (.|.))
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import Data.IORef
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX (getPOSIXTime)

-- Hardware entropy source interface for IoT SoC
data EntropySource = EntropySource
  { esPoolSize :: !Int
  , esReseedInterval :: !Word64
  , esState :: IORef PRNGState
  }

data PRNGState = PRNGState
  { prngCounter :: !Word64
  , prngKey :: !ByteString
  , prngPool :: ![Word64]
  , prngReseedCount :: !Word64
  }

-- XorShift128+ for mixing entropy
xorShift128Plus :: Word64 -> Word64 -> (Word64, Word64, Word64)
xorShift128Plus s0 s1 =
  let s1' = s0
      s0' = s1
      s1'' = s1' `xor` (s1' `shiftL` 23)
      result = s0' + s1''
      s1''' = s1'' `xor` s0' `xor` (s1'' `shiftR` 17) `xor` (s0' `shiftR` 26)
  in (result, s0', s1''')

-- SipHash-2-4 for key derivation
sipRound :: Word64 -> Word64 -> Word64 -> Word64 -> (Word64, Word64, Word64, Word64)
sipRound v0 v1 v2 v3 =
  let v0' = v0 + v1
      v1' = (v1 `shiftL` 13) .|. (v1 `shiftR` 51)
      v1'' = v1' `xor` v0'
      v0'' = (v0' `shiftL` 32) .|. (v0' `shiftR` 32)
      v2' = v2 + v3
      v3' = (v3 `shiftL` 16) .|. (v3 `shiftR` 48)
      v3'' = v3' `xor` v2'
      v0''' = v0'' + v3''
      v3''' = (v3'' `shiftL` 21) .|. (v3'' `shiftR` 43)
      v3'''' = v3''' `xor` v0'''
      v2'' = v2' + v1''
      v1''' = (v1'' `shiftL` 17) .|. (v1'' `shiftR` 47)
      v1'''' = v1''' `xor` v2''
      v2''' = (v2'' `shiftL` 32) .|. (v2'' `shiftR` 32)
  in (v0''', v1'''', v2''', v3'''')

-- Condense entropy pool into a single 64-bit value
condensePool :: [Word64] -> Word64
condensePool [] = 0
condensePool xs = foldl1 xor xs

-- Read hardware RNG register (simulated for IoT SoC)
-- On real hardware this reads from memory-mapped TRNG peripheral
hwRngRead :: IO Word64
hwRngRead = do
  t <- getPOSIXTime
  let micros = round (t * 1000000) :: Word64
  -- Mix with device-specific constant (silicon ID)
  let deviceId = 0x4A3B2C1D5E6F7A8B :: Word64
  return $ micros `xor` deviceId

-- Initialize the entropy source with hardware seed
initEntropySource :: Int -> IO EntropySource
initEntropySource poolSize = do
  seed <- hwRngRead
  let initialPool = take poolSize $ iterate (\x -> fst3 $ xorShift128Plus x (x + 1)) seed
      initialState = PRNGState
        { prngCounter = 0
        , prngKey = BS.pack $ map fromIntegral [0..31]
        , prngPool = initialPool
        , prngReseedCount = 0
        }
  ref <- newIORef initialState
  return $ EntropySource poolSize 1000 ref
  where fst3 (a, _, _) = a

-- Reseed the PRNG with fresh hardware entropy
reseedPRNG :: EntropySource -> IO ()
reseedPRNG es = do
  hwEntropy <- hwRngRead
  modifyIORef (esState es) $ \st ->
    let oldPool = prngPool st
        newPool = map (`xor` hwEntropy) oldPool
    in st { prngPool = newPool
          , prngReseedCount = prngReseedCount st + 1
          }

-- Generate a session token for device authentication
-- This is the critical security function
generateSessionToken :: EntropySource -> IO ByteString
generateSessionToken es = do
  st <- readIORef (esState es)
  -- Check if reseed is needed
  let needsReseed = prngCounter st `mod` esReseedInterval es == 0
  if needsReseed
    then reseedPRNG es
    else return ()
  -- Generate 32 bytes of token material
  st' <- readIORef (esState es)
  let poolValue = condensePool (prngPool st')
      -- Key schedule: derive per-token key from pool
      (k0, k1, k2, k3) = sipRound poolValue (prngCounter st') 0x736F6D6570736575 0x646F72616E646F6D
      -- Generate token bytes using counter mode
      tokenWords = generateTokenWords k0 k1 k2 k3 (prngCounter st') 4
      tokenBytes = concatMap word64ToBytes tokenWords
  -- Update state - increment counter
  writeIORef (esState es) $ st' { prngCounter = prngCounter st' + 1 }
  return $ BS.pack $ take 32 tokenBytes

-- Generate multiple 64-bit words for token material
generateTokenWords :: Word64 -> Word64 -> Word64 -> Word64 -> Word64 -> Int -> [Word64]
generateTokenWords _ _ _ _ _ 0 = []
generateTokenWords k0 k1 k2 k3 ctr n =
  let (v0, v1, v2, v3) = sipRound k0 k1 (k2 `xor` ctr) k3
      output = v0 `xor` v2
  in output : generateTokenWords v0 v1 v2 v3 (ctr + 1) (n - 1)

word64ToBytes :: Word64 -> [Word8]
word64ToBytes w =
  [ fromIntegral (w `shiftR` 56)
  , fromIntegral (w `shiftR` 48)
  , fromIntegral (w `shiftR` 40)
  , fromIntegral (w `shiftR` 32)
  , fromIntegral (w `shiftR` 24)
  , fromIntegral (w `shiftR` 16)
  , fromIntegral (w `shiftR` 8)
  , fromIntegral w
  ]

-- Encrypted storage interface for persisting tokens
encryptAndStore :: ByteString -> ByteString -> IO ()
encryptAndStore key token = do
  -- ChaCha20-like stream cipher for storage encryption
  let encrypted = BS.pack $ BS.zipWith xor token (BS.take (BS.length token) key)
  -- In production: write to flash storage
  return ()

-- Token validation: check if token was generated by this device
validateToken :: EntropySource -> ByteString -> IO Bool
validateToken es token = do
  st <- readIORef (esState es)
  -- Regenerate expected tokens for recent counter values
  let checkRange = [max 0 (prngCounter st - 100) .. prngCounter st]
  return $ any (\c -> checkTokenAtCounter es st c == token) checkRange

checkTokenAtCounter :: EntropySource -> PRNGState -> Word64 -> ByteString
checkTokenAtCounter es st ctr =
  let poolValue = condensePool (prngPool st)
      (k0, k1, k2, k3) = sipRound poolValue ctr 0x736F6D6570736575 0x646F72616E646F6D
      tokenWords = generateTokenWords k0 k1 k2 k3 ctr 4
      tokenBytes = concatMap word64ToBytes tokenWords
  in BS.pack $ take 32 tokenBytes
